description: This file contains utility functions for managing test suites, including filtering, cloning, and annotating test suite data within a testing framework, specifically for Playwright.

methods.name: filterSuite
methods.description: Filters a suite and its child suites and tests based on provided suite and test filters.

methods.name: filterTestsRemoveEmptySuites
methods.description: Removes tests and empty suites based on a filter, returning whether the suite has remaining entries.

methods.name: bindFileSuiteToProject
methods.description: Associates a test suite with a specific project, cloning it and assigning project-specific IDs and properties.

methods.name: applyRepeatEachIndex
methods.description: Applies a repeat index to tests within a suite, updating their IDs and worker hashes accordingly.

methods.name: filterOnly
methods.description: Filters a suite to only include items marked as 'only' for focused testing.

methods.name: filterSuiteWithOnlySemantics
methods.description: Recursively filters suites and tests to only include 'only' marked items.

methods.name: filterByFocusedLine
methods.description: Filters suites and tests based on specific file, line, and column focus filters.

methods.name: createFileMatcherFromFilter
methods.description: Creates a matcher function for test files based on provided filter criteria.
